# InternationalizationProvider03RtlDirection - Toggle text direction with the `dir` prop and watch Astryx components mirror. Pagination flips its prev/next chevrons under RTL. The `dir` prop is passed to both `InternationalizationProvider` (so Astryx components pick it up) and the `VStack` (so the DOM subtree mirrors); both channels stay in sync with no extra wrapper.
# Components: InternationalizationProvider, Pagination, SegmentedControl

<InternationalizationProvider />
<VStack gap={4}>
  <SegmentedControl />
  <SegmentedControlItem />
  <SegmentedControlItem />
  <Pagination variant="pages" />
</VStack>
